A bill for an act relating to pari-mutuel horse racing; appropriating money for support of Minnesota-bred Thoroughbred industry.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated to the Minnesota Racing Commission to supplement purses for races held exclusively for Minnesota-bred Thoroughbreds and provide grants, loans, and other financial incentives to breeders and owners, in order to promote, encourage, and support the Minnesota-bred Thoroughbred industry in the state and encourage breeding and racing of Thoroughbreds. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2029. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to pari-mutuel horse racing; appropriating money for support of Minnesota-bred Thoroughbred industry.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$2,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated to the Minnesota Racing Commission to supplement purses for races held exclusively for Minnesota-bred Thoroughbreds and provide grants, loans, and other financial incentives to breeders and owners, in order to promote, encourage, and support the Minnesota-bred Thoroughbred industry in the state and encourage breeding and racing of Thoroughbreds. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2029.
additions: $2,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated to the Minnesota Racing Commission to supplement purses for races held exclusively for Minnesota-bred Thoroughbreds and provide grants, loans, and other financial incentives to breeders and owners, in order to promote, encourage, and support the Minnesota-bred Thoroughbred industry in the state and encourage breeding and racing of Thoroughbreds. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2029.
